1.需要在书源登录真白萌，才能使用此书源；
2.章节获取内容失败且前面有🔒的标志，请去真白萌购买此章节，购买后不会去掉🔒，因为实在没找到判定购买的条件，但是刷新正文就有内容了；
3.我都要登录真白萌购买了，为什么还要用书源！为什么不能在APP里面就能购买？别问，问就是我懒，反正很多书都不需要金币也能看；
4.真白萌有访问次数限制，一分钟内不能访问太多次，所以别下载，大概率下载不到十章就一直失败；
5.基本上你一章一章阅读不会出现第3点的问题，如果出现内容失败，自己点一下刷新内容就行了；
6.现在登录按钮有两个功能了，一个登录，一个更新书源；
7.待补充；

<js>
(function() {
	var key = java.get('key');
	var page = java.get('page');
	var cookieHost = java.getCookie("https://masiro.me");

	var headers = {
		"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/138.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/138.0.0.0",
		"Referer": "https://masiro.me/admin/novels",
		"Connection": "keep-alive",
		"Cookie": cookieHost || "",
		"X-XSRF-TOKEN": getCookieValue(cookieHost, "XSRF-TOKEN")
	};
	java.put('searchHeaders', headers);

	var url = "https://masiro.me/admin/loadMoreNovels?page=" + page + 
			"&keyword=" + encodeURIComponent(key) +
			"&_t=" + Date.now();

	var response = java.get(url, headers);
	var responseData = JSON.parse(response.body());

	var resultList = [];

	if (responseData.code === 1) {
		responseData.novels.forEach(function(novel) {
			var tags = [];
			novel.tags.forEach(function(tag) {
				tags.push(tag.name);
			});

			var translators = [];
			novel.translators.forEach(function(translator) {
				translators.push(translator.name);
			});

			var coverUrl = "https://masiro.me" + novel.cover_img;

			var novelItem = {
				id: novel.id,
				title: novel.title,
				brief: novel.brief,
				author: novel.author,
				cover: coverUrl,
				status: novel.status, // 0=连载中, 1=已完结
				wordCount: novel.words,
				updateTime: novel.updated_at,
				latestChapter: novel.new_up_content,
				tags: tags.join(", "),
				translators: translators.join(", "),
				readCount: novel.read_num,
				collectCount: novel.collect_nums,
				likeCount: novel.thumb_up,
				sourceUrl: novel.original
			};
			resultList.push(novelItem);
		});
	} else {
		java.log("请求失败: " + (responseData.msg || "未知错误"));
	}
	//java.log(JSON.stringify(resultList));
	result = resultList;
})();
result;
</js>
